method.cli: external wall time includes spawn, startup and work; excludes compilation
method.steady: Date.now inside native/process program; 200 warmup calls, calibrated batches; exact checksum of every timed result checked against Node
method.npm: same esbuild neutral bundle for every runtime; package APIs tested, not runtime package resolution

profiles.perry: default native, prebuilt full stdlib; no V8 fallback flag
profiles.static-hermes: shermes -O; native executable dynamically links Hermes runtime on Linux; esbuild strips TS annotations
